why: Tests that read the repository BEYOND their own workspace (#2241). Turbo keys a
package's `test` task on that package's own files, so a scan whose SUBJECT is the
whole tree is replayed from cache whenever a SIBLING changes — and a scan that did
not run is indistinguishable from one that passed.
This file is the ONE list, read by two consumers that must not drift:
· repo-scan-authority-2241.test.ts      proves the list is COMPLETE, by deriving
the set from the AST rather than trusting
The ratchet is what makes the list safe to keep by hand: an entry nobody adds reds
it on the commit that adds the scan.
